newsitem.title: USA: Perceptron to restate 1996, 1995 results. [CORRECTED 23:21 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Perceptron to restate 1996, 1995 results. [CORRECTED 23:21 GMT]

text.p: Perceptron Inc on Wednesday said it was restating its results for the first nine months of 1996 to reflect a non-cash accounting charge of $2.1 million, or $0.27 a share.
The charge reflects a change in accounting methods for stock options.

Perceptron, which makes three-dimensional machine vision systems, also said it would restate its 1995 earnings to reflect the change, resulting in a charge of $900,000, (corrects figure from $900,00) or $0.12 a share.

For the first nine months of 1996, Perceptron said its restated earnings are $4.0 million, or $0.53 per share, compared to $6.1 million, or $0.80, as originally reported. No additional charges of this nature will be taken in the fourth quarter of 1996, the company said.
Net income for 1995 is restated at $8.4 million, or $1.16 per share, compared with $9.3 million, or $1.28, as originally reported.
